label: First name or me
summary: The character's first name, or a first-person word such as "me" when the text is spoken by that character.
details: Vanilla uses the name in a custom text ("bows deeply to [name]"), but through a differently named character. The "or me" part is read from the name, not documented.

label: First name or me, plain
summary: The same as the first name or "me" text, but without the hover tooltip on the name.
details: Vanilla uses the name in hunt texts such as "...but wounds [name]". The "or me" and "no tooltip" meanings are read from the name.

label: First name or me, plain, regnal
summary: The first name or "me" without a tooltip, in the form that carries the ruler's regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Going by its name, "Regnal" means the number after a ruler's name (the II in "Henry II"); the game documents nothing more.

label: First name or me, regnal
summary: The character's first name or "me", in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses the name once, at the start of a sentence (with the |U format) in an interaction tooltip: "[actor] join the invasion". The regnal meaning is read from the name.

label: First name, possessive
summary: The character's first name in the possessive form, such as "Edward's".
details: Vanilla uses it for the label of a camp leader and very often elsewhere in texts (about 630 uses of the name).

label: First name, possessive, plain
summary: The character's first name in the possessive form, as plain text without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it a lot, for example to name buildings after a legendary figure ("[name's] Shrine", "[name's] Mount").

label: First name, possessive, plain, regnal
summary: The possessive first name without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses it with an owner or earlier holder of an artifact ("[name's] Regnal Crown"). The regnal meaning is read from the name; the same-name uses are not on this type.

label: First name, possessive, or my
summary: The possessive first name, or "my" when the text is spoken by that character.
details: Vanilla uses it in a custom text ("clasps [...] hands"). The "or my" meaning is read from the name.

label: First name, possessive, or my, plain
summary: The possessive first name or "my", without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in tournament and hunt event texts. The "or my" meaning is read from the name.

label: Possessive first name or my, regnal
summary: The possessive first name or "my", without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: First name, possessive, or my, regnal
summary: The possessive first name or "my", in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: First name, possessive, regnal
summary: The character's possessive first name, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses it in event texts where a character is addressed ("my [relation], [name's] ..."). The regnal meaning is read from the name.

label: First name, regnal
summary: The character's first name, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses it in coronation event texts about a ruler. The regnal meaning (the II in "Henry II") is read from the name.

label: Focus
summary: The character's current lifestyle focus.
details: Vanilla reads the focus's name ("Current: ..."), its key and whether it is valid, that is, whether the character has a focus at all.

label: Forbidden personal tenet
summary: The forbidden tenet the character personally holds, if they hold one.
details: The game names no return type. Vanilla uses it in the text of the forbidden personal tenet secret: it checks the result with `IsValid` and only then adds the tenet's name in brackets, so it can be empty.

label: Full name
summary: The character's full name, with a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in the character window and in a rite's founding text ("was founded by [name]"). Used about 280 times in all.

label: Full name with nickname
summary: The character's full name together with their nickname.
details: Vanilla uses it for historical characters ("known as [name]").

label: Full name with nickname, plain
summary: The character's full name with nickname as plain text, without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in the character portrait tooltip, on a line before the debug info.

label: Full name with nickname, plain, regnal
summary: The full name with nickname, without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses it once, in the tooltip of a war ally, with the |T format. The regnal meaning is read from the name.

label: Full name with nickname or me
summary: The full name with nickname, or "me" when the text is spoken by that character.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed name or me, plain
summary: The full name with nickname or "me", without a hover tooltip.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed name or me, regnal
summary: The full name with nickname or "me", without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed name or me, regnal
summary: The full name with nickname or "me", in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name with nickname, possessive
summary: The full name with nickname in the possessive form ("Edward the Bold's").
details: Vanilla uses it once, in a court event text where a ward's "sad eyes" are described. The example form is only an illustration of the name's wording.

label: Full name with nickname, possessive, plain
summary: The possessive full name with nickname, without a hover tooltip.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed possessive name, regnal
summary: The possessive full name with nickname, without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed possessive name or my
summary: The possessive full name with nickname, or "my" when the text is spoken by that character.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed possessive or my, plain
summary: The possessive full name with nickname or "my", without a hover tooltip.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed possessive or my, regnal
summary: The possessive full name with nickname or "my", without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Nicknamed possessive or my, regnal
summary: The possessive full name with nickname or "my", in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name with nickname, possessive, regnal
summary: The possessive full name with nickname, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name with nickname, regnal
summary: The full name with nickname, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, plain
summary: The character's full name as plain text, without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of labels in the activity planner and in the ledger.

label: Full name, plain, regnal
summary: The full name without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses it once in a flavor event text about foreign merchants. The regnal meaning is read from the name; that line is on a differently named character.

label: Full name or me
summary: The character's full name, or "me" when the text is spoken by that character.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name or me, plain
summary: The full name or "me", without a hover tooltip.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name or me, plain, regnal
summary: The full name or "me", without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name or me, regnal
summary: The full name or "me", in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, possessive
summary: The character's full name in the possessive form.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tournament results window, where the winner's name is built from a guest list.

label: Full name, possessive, plain
summary: The character's possessive full name, without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in succession event texts ("[name's] spirit has flown to ..."). Those lines are on a differently named character.

label: Full name, possessive, plain, regnal
summary: The possessive full name without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, possessive, or my
summary: The possessive full name, or "my" when the text is spoken by that character.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, possessive, or my, plain
summary: The possessive full name or "my", without a hover tooltip.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Possessive full name or my, regnal
summary: The possessive full name or "my", without a tooltip, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, possessive, or my, regnal
summary: The possessive full name or "my", in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, possessive, regnal
summary: The possessive full name, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Nothing in the game's texts uses it. Everything here is read from its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Full name, regnal
summary: The character's full name, in the form that carries the regnal number.
details: Vanilla uses it in a struggle event text about a prisoner ("[name] is a prisoner at my mercy"). The regnal meaning is read from the name; those lines are on a differently named character.

label: Glow tint color
summary: A four-part color value (a CVector4f) tied to the character's glow.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name and its return type, it is probably a tint color for the GUI; the game documents nothing more.

label: Gold
summary: The amount of gold the character has.
details: Vanilla shows it in the character and intrigue windows (with the |0 format) and dims a ledger row when it is exactly 0.

label: Gold tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the character's gold, including its balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the gold display in the character, intrigue and ledger windows.

label: Government
summary: The character's government.
details: Vanilla reads from it the government's adjective, whether it is a given type (for example the celestial government) and its domicile type.

label: Health
summary: The character's health value, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it only in the character's debug tooltips, with one decimal ('Health: ...').

label: Health icon frame
summary: The number of the health icon picture that fits the character's health state.
details: Vanilla compares it with 4 in the multiplayer lobby, where a landless ruler's name is shown with age and health. What frame 4 stands for is not given.

label: Health info
summary: The tooltip text that describes the character's health.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the outliner and the shared tooltip, and as the "alive" tooltip in the character window.

label: Heir to
summary: A text that says whose heir the character is.
details: Vanilla shows it in the shared character tooltip. Going by its name and that use, it describes the titles or people the character is heir to.

label: Held baronies
summary: How many baronies the character holds, as a whole number.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name and return type; the game documents nothing more.

label: Court and council positions
summary: A text listing the court and council positions the character holds.
details: Vanilla uses it in a tooltip that begins with the character's liege ("[liege's] [positions]").

label: Held court position
summary: The court position of the given type that the character holds.
details: Takes a court position type. The game names no return type. Vanilla uses it in the message about a court position being replaced: it takes the new holder's position of that type and shows its aptitude text.

label: Held court positions
summary: The list of court positions the character holds.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Held court positions text
summary: A text naming the court positions the character holds.
details: Vanilla event texts use a differently named character with it as a title for someone ("my [position], [name]"). Going by its name and those uses.

label: Her or him
summary: The pronoun for the character as an object, "her" or "him" by gender.
details: Used around 3,770 times in vanilla texts, for example in "pinning [her/him] in the Outliner". The wording of the pronoun is read from the function's name.

label: Her or his
summary: The possessive word for the character, "her" or "his" by gender.
details: Used around 9,500 times in vanilla texts, for example "according to [her/his] Personality".

label: Her, his or my
summary: The possessive word for the character: "her" or "his" by gender, or "my" when the character is the speaker.
details: Vanilla uses it at the start of a label in the inventory window (with the |U format). The "my" case is read from the name, not documented.

label: Her, his or your
summary: The possessive word for the character: "her" or "his" by gender, or "your" when it is the player.
details: Vanilla uses it in a situation tooltip ("[name] and [her/his/your] tributaries"). The "your" case is read from the name, not documented.

label: Herd and raised horde
summary: The size of the character's herd together with their raised horde, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the Great Steppe window as the nomad's herd size, with no decimals.

label: Hers or his
summary: The stand-alone possessive word for the character, "hers" or "his" by gender.
details: Vanilla uses it in event texts through differently named characters. Going by its name and those uses.

label: Herself or himself
summary: The word 'herself' or 'himself', matching the character.
details: Vanilla uses it in many texts (over 20 uses), for example in death reasons: 'drank [herself/himself] to death'.

label: History ID
summary: The character's ID from the game's history files, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it only in the character's debug tooltips ('Historical ID: ...'), next to the normal ID. What it gives for a character not from the history files is not shown.

label: Home court
summary: The character's home court.
details: Vanilla uses it in the character window as a data source (through the window's own character function), so this is a hint rather than a direct use.

label: Hook on
summary: The hook the character holds on another character.
details: Takes the other character. Vanilla only has a line about a hook that is about to expire; the rest is read from the name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the hook is held on.

label: Hook or hookable secrets frame
summary: The number of the icon picture to show, depending on hooks the character has or secrets that could become hooks.
details: Vanilla uses it as the frame of an icon in the shared portrait and list GUIs. What each number stands for is not given.

label: Hostage tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the character's hostage status.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of a hostage icon in the shared portrait GUI.

label: Hostile raiders
summary: The list of hostile raiders linked to the character.
details: Vanilla only has a line where the HUD uses it through the player's own character, as a data source. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: House
summary: The house (noble family) the character belongs to.
details: Vanilla reads the house's base name and uses it in the "Head of Powerful Family" and "Head of Dominant Family" texts.

label: Human player name
summary: The name of the human player who plays the character.
details: Vanilla shows it in the faction window ("Played by ...") and in the character window.

label: Human player name if not you
summary: The name of the human player who plays the character, unless that player is the one looking.
details: Vanilla uses it in the multiplayer lobby ("Played by ..."). What it gives when it is the local player is read from the name, not documented.

label: Character ID
summary: The character's ID number.
details: Vanilla passes it to GUI actions that open the diarchy view or handle a click on the character, and to the lifestyle focus description.

label: Imprisoned by
summary: The character who holds this character in prison.
details: Vanilla uses its UI name in a tooltip ("imprisoned by ...").

label: Imprisonment reasons
summary: A text listing the crimes that justify imprisoning the character.
details: Takes the character who would do the imprisoning. Vanilla uses it with a differently named character, in texts like "has committed crimes (...) allowing you to imprison".

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who would imprison them.

label: Income as religious head
summary: The income the character gets as head of a religion.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name and return type (a number); the game documents nothing more.

label: Religious head income breakdown
summary: The breakdown of the character's income as head of a religion, as a value breakdown.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a part of the character window.

label: Lease income breakdown
summary: A text that shows how the character's income from a theocratic lease is made up.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tooltip of the church property (temples held under a theocratic lease).

label: Lease income
summary: The income the character gets from temples held under a theocratic lease.
details: Vanilla shows it in the church property tooltip. A related text calls it taxes per month.

label: Influence
summary: The amount of influence the character has.
details: Vanilla shows it in the character window and the ledger, with no decimals.

label: Influence balance
summary: How much influence the character gains or loses per period.
details: Vanilla shows it in the ledger with its sign, and shows the row only when it is at least 1.

label: Influence level
summary: The character's influence level, as a whole number.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name and return type; the game documents nothing more.

label: Influence level picture
summary: The picture that shows the character's influence level.
details: Vanilla uses it as an image in the character window and the ledger.

label: Influence progress
summary: How far the character has come toward the next influence level.
details: Vanilla uses it as the value of a progress bar in the ledger.

label: Influence tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the character's influence, including its balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the character window and the ledger.

label: Intent target
summary: The character that is the target of this character's activity intent.
details: Vanilla shows its short UI name ("Target: ...") and uses its validity to show or hide the event widget, so it can be empty.

label: Interloper struggles
summary: The list of struggles in which the character is an interloper.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Inventory
summary: The character's inventory.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of a part of the royal court window.

label: Investment cap
summary: The most the character can invest, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the government administration window next to the "investment cap" concept.

label: Involved activity
summary: The activity the character takes part in.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data source in the HUD, and about 100 times in all.

label: Activity intent
summary: The intent the character has chosen for the activity they take part in.
details: Vanilla shows its name ("Intent: ...") and uses it as a data source in the activity window.

label: Migration situation
summary: The migration situation the character is involved in.
details: Vanilla shows its name in a "click to view" text and uses it as the data source of the migration window.

label: Involved situations
summary: The list of situations the character is involved in.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Involved struggles
summary: The list of struggles the character is involved in.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Join court date
summary: The date the character joined the court.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Killer
summary: The character who killed this character.
details: Vanilla shows its UI name ("Killer: ...") and checks that it is valid, so it can be empty. The check is only made in debug mode.

label: Kills
summary: The list of characters this character has killed.
details: Vanilla counts it in the legacy window ("Kills: ...").

label: Knight army
summary: The army the character serves in as a knight.
details: Vanilla shows its name in texts such as "Serving as a knight in [army]".

label: Knight breakdown
summary: A breakdown of the character's knights.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Knight count
summary: The number of knights the character has.
details: Vanilla uses a global function of the same name in knight-limit texts and a hired troop's function in a list. Going by its name; the use on this type is not shown.

label: Knight effectiveness
summary: How effective the character's knights are, as a percentage.
details: Vanilla shows it in the ledger as a percentage with its sign, and highlights it when it is above 1 for a ruler.

label: Knight effectiveness breakdown
summary: A text showing what the character's knight effectiveness is made of.
details: Vanilla uses it as a text in the ledger.

label: Knights
summary: The list of the character's knights.
details: Vanilla counts it in the ledger and shows or dims entries depending on whether the list has items.

label: Known languages
summary: The list of languages the character knows.
details: Vanilla shows a part of the character window only when the list has more than one language.

label: Known languages text
summary: A text listing the languages the character knows.
details: Vanilla uses it in the known languages tooltip.

label: Lady or lord
summary: The word "lady" or "lord" for the character, by gender.
details: Vanilla uses it around 345 times, for example in culture title texts (with the |U format). The gender choice is read from the name.

label: Last court events date
summary: The date when the pending court events of the character were last triggered.
details: Vanilla uses it in the royal court window ("Since you last attended court (date)"), written out in long form.

label: Legend seeds
summary: The list of legend seeds the character has.
details: Vanilla counts it, together with the player's triggered legend seeds, in the legends window and the HUD.

label: Legitimacy
summary: The character's legitimacy value.
details: Vanilla shows it in the legitimacy track title next to the maximum, in the ledger, and hides a HUD part when it is exactly 0.

label: Liege legitimacy expectation
summary: The legitimacy level the character's liege expects from them.
details: Vanilla shows it in the "expected legitimacy" tooltip of vassals and compares it with the character's level to tell when it is below expectations.

label: Legitimacy level
summary: The character's current legitimacy level.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data source in the HUD and to pick the flavor name of the level in a situation window.

label: Legitimacy type
summary: The kind of legitimacy that applies to the character.
details: Vanilla reads from it the flavor name of a level and an icon of its levels.

label: Lease levies breakdown
summary: A text showing how the levies from the character's theocratic lease are made up.
details: Vanilla uses it in the church property tooltip.

label: Lease levies
summary: The number of levies the character gets from temples held under a theocratic lease.
details: Vanilla uses it in the church property tooltip.

label: Liege
summary: The character's liege.
details: Vanilla reads from it the short UI name and whether the liege is female. Used about 180 times.

label: Liege, even if dead
summary: The character's liege, also when that liege has died.
details: Vanilla reads the liege's title as a name in a culture text (co-ruler title). The difference to the plain liege is read from the name.

label: Liege title, even if dead
summary: The title of the character's liege, also when that liege has died.
details: Vanilla only has a line where the character window uses it as a data source, through the window's own character function.

label: Lifestyle
summary: The lifestyle the character currently follows.
details: Vanilla compares its key with a lifestyle's key in the lifestyle window and checks that it is valid.

label: Lifestyle experience progress
summary: How far the character has come toward the next level of a lifestyle, as a fraction.
details: Takes a lifestyle. Vanilla only has a HUD line using it with the player's character as the value of a bar.

label: Lifestyle experience
summary: The experience the character has in a lifestyle.
details: Takes a lifestyle and a yes/no flag. Vanilla always passes yes and shows the result with no decimals next to the experience needed per level. What the flag changes is not documented.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: A yes/no flag; the game documents no meaning.

label: Localized text
summary: A text of the character, looked up by key.
details: Takes the key of a text. Vanilla uses it with differently named characters to show texts stored under a key (a new artifact name, a cat name). Going by those uses.

label: Location description
summary: A text that describes where the character is.
details: Vanilla uses it in the character window, in a map icon tooltip and in the "go to" tooltip of an interaction window.

label: Log name
summary: The character's name for the game's log.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Marriage icon frame
summary: The number of the marriage icon picture to show.
details: Takes one value. Vanilla only has lines using it on a marriage info object in marriage notifications, so this is a hint; what the value is and what the frames mean is not given.

label: Marriage icon tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the marriage icon.
details: Takes one value. Vanilla only has a line using it in the character window through the window's own function, so this is a hint; what the value is is not given.

label: Maximum consorts
summary: The most consorts (concubines) the character may have.
details: Vanilla uses it in the character window, with the spouse limit, to decide which spouse or concubine part is shown, and compares the concubine list size with 3 next to it, so consorts here means concubines.

label: Maximum domain fertility
summary: The highest domain fertility value of the character, as a whole number.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name and return type; the game documents nothing more.

label: Maximum lease income
summary: The most gold per month the character could get from a theocratic lease, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the character window's church obligations text, after the income actually received: '... /month (out of possible [this]/month)'. What a theocratic lease is exactly is not described there.

label: Maximum lease levies
summary: The most levies (soldiers) the character could get from a theocratic lease, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the character window's church obligations text, after the levies actually received: '(out of possible [this])'.

label: Maximum merit level
summary: The highest merit level the character can reach.
details: Vanilla adds 1 to it and compares it with a list index in the HUD, to show the merit steps.

label: Maximum military strength
summary: The highest military strength the character can have.
details: Vanilla uses it in the confederation window: the part is shown when it is not 0, and it is the maximum of a bar.

label: Maximum military strength without hires
summary: The highest military strength the character can have, not counting hired troops.
details: Vanilla shows it in the house view as "Maximum Military Strength".

label: Maximum spouses
summary: The most spouses the character may have at the same time.
details: Vanilla uses it in the character window: more than 1 makes it show the part for several spouses.

label: Maximum tax slots
summary: The number of tax slots (jurisdictions) the character can have.
details: Vanilla shows it as the total in the tax jurisdiction headers, next to the number in use.

label: Memories
summary: The list of the character's memories.
details: Nothing in the game's files uses it. Going by its name; the game documents nothing more.

label: Men-at-arms strength
summary: The combined strength of the character's men-at-arms.
details: Vanilla shows it as a number in the ledger.

label: Merit
summary: The character's merit value.
details: Vanilla shows it with no decimals next to the character's name in the administration window.

label: Merit balance
summary: How much merit the character gains or loses per period.
details: Vanilla shows it with its sign in the ledger, and shows the row only when it is at least 1.

label: Merit balance breakdown
summary: A text showing what the character's merit balance is made of.
details: Vanilla uses it as a text in the HUD.

label: Merit level
summary: The character's merit level, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it to look up the effects of a level, to show a HUD part from level 1, and compares it with 9 in the ledger.

label: Merit level description
summary: A text that describes a merit level.
details: Takes one value. Vanilla uses it in the merit bar marker tooltip; what exactly the value is (a level number is likely) is not shown in the input.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented by the game; probably the level.

label: Merit level text icon
summary: The merit level's icon, written so it can sit inside a text.
details: Vanilla uses it with a differently named character in a ministry appointment text, followed by the merit modifier's name.

label: Merit level picture
summary: The picture that shows the character's merit level.
details: Vanilla uses it as an image in the HUD.

label: Merit progress
summary: How far the character has come toward the next merit level.
details: Vanilla uses it as the value of a ledger bar, and shows 100 instead when the level is 9.

label: Merit tooltip
summary: The tooltip text about the character's merit, including its balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the ledger.

label: Military strength text
summary: A text showing the character's military strength.
details: Vanilla uses it in brackets after a character's name in migration war texts, and in the migration window.
